issue create --title Carried rows lose their estimate marks on publish --label swarm-followup --label from-pr-1911 --label blocked --body Blocked on PR #1911 merging (the publish seed does not exist on the default branch until then). 
  
 ## Goal 
 Gap-filled values copied at publish keep their provisional marks, so estimates do not look like vetted source values until a refresh rewrites the row. Found by the self-review on PR #1911 (head 8cbd8ea). 
  
 ## Constraints 
 Per-cell marks live in `fact_commonwealth_cell_envelope`, keyed by `fact_id`, and carried rows get new ids.

issue create --title seedFromPrevious comment overclaims which tables are carried --label swarm-followup --label from-pr-1911 --label blocked --body Blocked on PR #1911 merging. 
  
 ## Goal 
 The seed comment stops saying new scenario-aware tables are carried automatically: only tables that already have the `carried` column are. 
  
 ## Constraints 
 Pick one: reword the comment, or require the column in each new table's migration. 
  
 ## Acceptance criteria 
 - [ ] The comment in `CandidateLifecycleService.seedFromPrevious` matches the behaviour, or the migration requirement is doc

issue create --title Narrow the coarse published-parity register rows after the first real run --label swarm-followup --label from-pr-1912 --label blocked --body Blocked on PR #1912 merging and on the first published-parity run on minti9 (needs real results). 
  
 ## Goal 
 The Resource-wealth and cross-border Net Worth register rows cover whole ranges and could hide a real gap. Replace them with per-country or per-year rows. 
  
 ## Constraints 
 Use a new migration; do not edit V264 once merged. 
  
 ## Acceptance criteria 
 - [ ] Each replacement row cites evidence from the first m

issue create --title Add an admin nav link to the published-parity page --label swarm-followup --label from-pr-1912 --label blocked --body Blocked on PR #1912 merging. 
  
 ## Goal 
 `/admin/published-parity` is reachable from the admin refresh page, not only by URL and the display-parity text. 
  
 ## Constraints 
 Follow the existing display-parity link. 
  
 ## Acceptance criteria 
 - [ ] A link sits beside the display-parity link in `templates/admin/refresh.html`. 
  
 ## Pointers 
 PR #1912 follow-up 3. 
  
 ## Out of scope 
 Any change to the page itself.
